pages.text: Place the egg, then right-click to begin hatching. It incubates, floats while spinning and pulling nearby blocks, then drops them and spawns your Mini Me clone before vanishing in a small blast.

The egg remembers its placer as owner. During the float phase it may magnet nearby blocks if enabled in config. Watch for END_ROD particles while it works. Mini Me inherits your skin and follows you like a tiny helper.
